text:
按美国财政部日前公布的2026年8月季度再融资计划中的暂定回购时间表，9月国债回购安排如下。财政部回购操作时间均为美国东部时间13:40–14:00，即北京时间次日01:40—02:00（美国夏令时期间）。
需要特别注意：美国财政部8月19日已经宣布，从9月9日起，10年至20年期和20年至30年期名义附息国债的流动性支持回购规模将至少翻倍至每次至少40亿美元，这一调整适用于本轮再融资季度剩余时间。因此，表中的原暂定最高规模20亿美元，后续应以财政部更新后的回购时间表为准。其中，9月10日和9月24日两次长期名义国债回
text_en:
According to the tentative buyback schedule in the U.S. Treasury's August 2026 quarterly refunding announcement released recently, September Treasury buyback operations are arranged as follows. Treasury buyback operations will run 13:40–14:00 ET, i.e., 01:40–02:00 Beijing time the next day (during U.S. daylight saving time).
Note: On August 19, the U.S. Treasury announced that starting September 9, liquidity support buyback sizes for 10-to-20-year and 20-to-30-year nominal coupon Treasuries will be at least doubled to at least $4 billion per operation, with the adjustment applying for the remainder of the current refunding quarter. Therefore, the original tentative maximum of $2 billion in the table should give way to the Treasury's updated buyback schedule.
